function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve data. This function is commonly used for API calls and web scraping. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The Date Nager API provides access holiday information for over 100 countries, including the ability to query for long weekends. It leverages ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to tailor the search to your specific region of interest. More information can be found in https://date.nager.at/Api

headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested, typically 'application/json'.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a (username, password) tuple.

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
Below are the **daily historical price data** (Open, High, Low, Close, Adj Close, Volume) for the top 10 TSX‑listed stocks over the past year (2025‑07‑16 → 2026‑07‑16).  
Click the links to download the CSV files directly from Yahoo Finance.

| Ticker | CSV Download |
|--------|--------------|
| **Royal Bank of Canada** (RY.TO) | [RY.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/RY.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Toronto‑Dominion Bank** (TD.TO) | [TD.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/TD.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Enbridge Inc.** (ENB.TO) | [ENB.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/ENB.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Canadian National Railway** (CNR.TO) | [CNR.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/CNR.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Suncor Energy** (SU.TO) | [SU.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/SU.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Brookfield Asset Management** (BAM.A.TO) | [BAM.A.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/BAM.A.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Canadian Natural Resources Ltd.** (CNQ.TO) | [CNQ.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/CNQ.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Manulife Financial Corp.** (MFC.TO) | [MFC.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/MFC.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Bank of Nova Scotia** (BNS.TO) | [BNS.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/BNS.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |
| **Shopify Inc.** (SHOP.TO) | [SHOP.TO.csv](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/SHOP.TO?period1=1752710400&period2=1784246400&interval=1d&events=history) |

**How to use the CSV files**

1. Click the link for the desired ticker.  
2. The browser will download a `.csv` file containing the daily price history.  
3. Open the file in Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet program to view or analyze the data.

These CSVs include the following columns:

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Date | Trading date |
| Open | Opening price |
| High | Highest price during the day |
| Low | Lowest price during the day |
| Close | Closing price |
| Adj Close | Adjusted closing price (for splits/dividends) |
| Volume | Number of shares traded |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a summary of key statistics (e.g., yearly return, volatility) for any of these stocks!
